inspiration.observed_pattern: MariaDB adds an inline LIMIT clause to GROUP_CONCAT so an ordered aggregate can retain only its top-ranked values.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a deterministic label leaderboard. GROUP_CONCAT orders fixed labels by score and uses LIMIT 2 inside the aggregate, while a grouped final read verifies one bounded label list per segment. The release-note wording and examples are not copied.

fixture_notes: Each segment has three labels; the aggregate must retain only the two highest scores with the label as a deterministic tie-breaker.
determinism_notes: Segment IDs, labels, scores, aggregate ordering, separator, and LIMIT are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE segment_labels (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, segment_id INT NOT NULL, label_name VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, label_score INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT segment_id, GROUP_CONCAT(label_name ORDER BY label_score DESC, label_name ASC SEPARATOR ',' LIMIT 2) AS top_labels FROM segment_labels GROUP BY segment_id ORDER BY segment_id

checks.sql: SELECT label_id, segment_id, label_name, label_score FROM segment_labels ORDER BY label_id
